expectations.text: measures-without-height-zero: measure inner auto-height node, not the constrained animating element
expectations.evidence: Two-element outer clipper + inner content; RO observes inner content at natural height; 'if you put both jobs on one element youre back to fighting the browser'.

expectations.text: resizeobserver-changing-content: RO so height updates on reflow/async content
expectations.evidence: RO subscribed to inner content while open; re-pins height on any size change; table row 'Content changes while open'.

expectations.text: animate-px-then-auto: handles height:auto animation correctly; accounts for auto after transition
expectations.evidence: Explains cant transition to/from auto, feeds pixel value; keeps px-pinned deliberately, discusses tradeoff of not snapping to auto (notes/trade-offs).

expectations.text: correct-measure-timing: useLayoutEffect/rAF/RO, Math.ceil to avoid clipping
expectations.evidence: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect; getBoundingClientRect fractional to avoid 1px clip; borderBoxSize for transform safety. (No Math.ceil, but uses fractional read.)
